ideas.pitch: Real-time biomechanical walking gait analyzer using MediaPipe and posture classification for early neurological disorder screening in clinical settings.
ideas.title: BioGait AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of hard engineering combined with computer vision demonstrated in CricketVision_AI, directly addressing clinical relevance for a bioinformatics hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Personalized dietary recommendation web app that adjusts macro goals based on simulated metabolic biomarker panels.
ideas.title: NutriGene AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the successful nutrition and wellness assistant execution seen in E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant, appealing to health judges with a polished, consumer-facing demo.

ideas.pitch: Bilingual emergency symptom triage platform featuring rPPG contactless heart rate estimation and automated severity scoring.
ideas.title: MediTriage Multi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines vital sign extraction and multi-language triage as proven by the 2nd place winner mediscan-ai, proving immediate utility for healthcare workflows.

ideas.pitch: Interactive clinical simulation training app providing real-time camera-based feedback on chest compression rate and depth.
ideas.title: SimPatient CPR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the Cornell AI Hackathon grand prize winner Clinical-Simulator by utilizing pose estimation for actionable physical training feedback that judges can test live.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient onboarding and trust verification platform designed for specialized biomedical clinics.
ideas.title: BioClinic Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the fast-turnaround workflow model of Global-Smile, delivering a clean enterprise healthcare interface with demonstrable business logic within a short sprint.
